Package io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities

Class Entity

java.lang.Object
io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities.Entity
Direct Known Subclasses:
Goose, Item, Projectile, Student
public class Entity extends Object
Entity stores a Sprite, a collision geometry Circle, and its centre, and rotation. It is a generic class for any object with a texture and collision detection.
